question.text:
Match List - I with List - II.
  List - I   List - II
a Torque i MLT-1
b Impulse ii MT-2
c Tension iii ML2 T-2
d Surface Tension iv MLT-2

Choose the most appropriate answer from the option given below :

solution.text: The torque is defined as, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>τ</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>⊥</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>F</mi><mi>sin</mi><mi>θ</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>ML</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>, the formula of impulse, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>I</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>∆</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>MLT</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> and tension, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>T</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>MLT</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> and the formula of surface tension is defined as force per unit length.<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>F</mi><mi>l</mi></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>M</mi><mi>L</mi><msup><mi>T</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mi>L</mi></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mi>M</mi><msup><mi>T</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>.
